Whether Chromium should pretend to be in dark mode by emulating the media feature 'prefers-color-scheme: dark'. Default is `false`.

## CLI flag

Use `--dark-mode` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag          |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                           | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                           | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                             | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)               | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                     | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)                                 | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)             | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)               | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions) | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)         | `--dark-mode` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)           | `--dark-mode` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`getCompositionsOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/getcompositionsonlambda#darkmode)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#darkmode)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#darkmode)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#darkmode)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#darkmode)

## Config file

```tsx twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';

// ---cut---
Config.setChromiumDarkMode(true);
```
